comparison.objective: Snap a sip lid fully around a filled paper cup; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Progressive circumferential pressing while avoiding cup tip or wall crush versus two-tool angular adjustment and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: All eight lid sectors are seated with the cup intact and hands clear; candidate requires a precise retained opening over repeated actuation.
comparison.reason: Distributed snap-fit seating under container-damage constraints does not overlap the candidate's adjustable-stop retention ability.
